uncited: - **Blocked Edges**: Contraction of an edge is prevented if its reach value is greater than or equal to the rank of the advancing front.
- **Degenerate Input**: Noisy datasets may produce many small disconnected components.
- **Time Complexity**: The algorithm performs one pass over the cross-sections.
Each extraction step is $O(N_{layer})$ where $N_{layer}$ is the number of cells in the layer.
Simplification involves edge collapses, each taking time proportional to the degree of the vertices involved.
The total time is dominated by the number of edge collapses, which is bounded by the number of triangles in the final mesh.
- **Memory Complexity**: The memory usage is bounded by the size of the current layer plus the simplified history.
The Tandem Algorithm ensures that the number of vertices and triangles in memory is proportional to the surface area of the extracted portion, not the volume.
